service.ar: إلغاء عقد عمل عامل خدمة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کا معاہدہ منسوخ کرنا

about: An employer asks to cancel a domestic worker's work contract and residence permit.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 65 to cancel the residence permit (also AED 65 for an exceptional cancellation)
timing: Any fines must be paid first
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Ministry of Human Resources & Emiratisation
